sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Short (~120 ms) noisy burst confined to the upper-mid band, no tonal lines and no matching visual beat (only a slow card scale). Could be a soft whoosh or a music percussion hit; CLAP's swoosh_reverse score is weak.

pattern.description: The recreated Cirrus website sits in a rounded browser card over the purple brand gradient and slowly scales up (~1%) while all of its contents stay locked in place.
pattern.why_premium: A continuous, barely perceptible push keeps a static web page alive during narration and draws the eye in without ever cutting or panning.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo(browserCard, {scale: 1}, {scale: 1.03, duration: 2.5, ease: 'sine.inOut', transformOrigin: '50% 50%'}); card contents are children so they scale together, no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 75], [1, 1.03], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin)}) on the card wrapper; no spring (no overshoot visible).

notes: camera.move is none and the gradient background stays put, so this is the card scaling inside the frame, not a camera move. Cursor and page content move only with the card.
